description: List fields in a table — returns id, name, and type per field (lightweight by default). Use instead of `get_table_schema` when you need fields only (no view data). Set includeOptions=true to also return each field's full typeOptions (can be very large on wide tables — prefer the default for name/id/type lookups). Use `fieldType` or `nameContains` filters on large tables to reduce context size. Returns [{ id, name, type, typeOptions? }].

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

fieldType.description: Return only fields of this type, e.g. "formula", "text", "number", "checkbox"

includeOptions.description: Include full typeOptions per field (default false — the payload can exceed the MCP response window on wide tables)

nameContains.description: Return only fields whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive)

tableIdOrName.description: The table ID (tblXXX) or exact name

name: list_fields
